title: Posted Price List for Feed and Animal Nutrition Programmes
content:
Posted prices and the basis on which a ton is priced, for each of the Feed and Animal Nutrition Programmes.

| Programme | Basis of the price of a ton | Bagged complete feed (per ton) | Bulk complete feed (per ton) | Mixing charge on the member's own formula (per ton) | Mineral (per ton) | Milk replacer (per bag) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Bagged Feed Cash Account | the posted bag price on the day | $585.00 | $0.00 | $0.00 | $790.00 | $92.50 |
| Bulk Delivered Feed Account | the posted bulk price on the delivery day | $585.00 | $498.00 | $0.00 | $762.00 | $92.50 |
| Custom Mix Ration Program | ingredient cost plus the mixing charge | $585.00 | $498.00 | $28.50 | $762.00 | $92.50 |
| Contracted Ingredient Program | contracted ingredient cost plus the mixing charge | $585.00 | $498.00 | $26.00 | $748.00 | $92.50 |
| Full Nutrition Partner Program | contracted ingredient cost plus the mixing charge | $585.00 | $486.00 | $22.50 | $735.00 | $88.00 |
| Medicated Feed VFD Program | ingredient cost plus the mixing charge | $612.00 | $524.00 | $34.00 | $762.00 | $92.50 |

## How contracted ingredients are priced, and how long a quote stands

| Programme | Basis on which contracted ingredients are priced | A counter quote is held for |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Bagged Feed Cash Account | not offered | 0 calendar days |
| Bulk Delivered Feed Account | not offered | 7 calendar days |
| Custom Mix Ration Program | the posted ingredient price on the day the mix is run | 7 calendar days |
| Contracted Ingredient Program | the contracted price until the contracted tons are exhausted, and the posted price afterwards | 14 calendar days |
| Full Nutrition Partner Program | the contracted price until the contracted tons are exhausted, and the posted price afterwards | 14 calendar days |
| Medicated Feed VFD Program | the posted ingredient price on the day the mix is run | 7 calendar days |

Bulk complete feed and the mixing charge stand at nothing on the Bagged Feed Cash Account, and the mixing charge at nothing on the Bulk Delivered Feed Account. Mineral and milk replacer are posted on every programme, mineral highest on the Bagged Feed Cash Account at seven hundred and ninety dollars a ton and lowest on the Full Nutrition Partner Program at seven hundred and thirty-five, and milk replacer at ninety-two dollars and fifty cents a bag everywhere except the Full Nutrition Partner Program, where it is eighty-eight dollars.

*Hypothetical.* A quote given at the counter on a Contracted Ingredient Program stands for fourteen calendar days from the day it was given; the same quote given on a Bulk Delivered Feed Account stands for seven.
